address: 2nd Floor, Centria Mall, 210 Olaya Street, Al Olaya, Riyadh, 11672, Saudi Arabia
bio: Enjoy a small break from shopping at this Japanese restaurant located on Centria Mall’s second floor. Take in the relaxing atmosphere and serene modern surroundings while you wait for your food. As for the menu, you’ll have plenty of options, from classic sushi to crisp tempura, robata and yakitori grills. The dishes are best enjoyed with a few friends so you can try as many dishes as possible. Be sure to order one of their mocktails, as they are some of the best in the city.
